_finding: The agent test store publishes one grade per test. Grading after the window, or grading again when a grade exists, would let a tester retry until a pass (docs/agent-test-tz.md v3 §2.1, §5.2).

mutations.name: a second submission is graded again
mutations.find: if (prior) return [200, answerResponse(prior)] // a lost response, fetched again: the first grade, unchanged
mutations.expect: FAIL ...even after the window: a lost response can be fetched again

mutations.name: answers after the window are graded
mutations.find: if (t > Date.parse(raw.expires_at)) return [410, { error: 'the answer window has closed' }]
mutations.expect: FAIL an answer after the window is 410
